days.title: City Sightseeing Helsinki Hop-On Hop-Off Bus Tour + Helsinki Canal Cruise
days.body:
Morning – After breakfast , Take a city tour of Helsinki in a Hop on Hop Bus.
Hop-on hop-off Helsinki City Sightseeing tour by double-decker bus Create a personalized sightseeing itinerary to suit your schedule See top Helsinki attractions such as Temppeliaukio Church and Ateneum Hop off for a stroll around Sibelius Park and see its famous monument
Helsinki Canal Cruise
1.5-hour Helsinki sightseeing cruise Admire the rugged coastline that frames the city See top Helsinki attractions such as Helsinki Zoo and Degerö Canal Cruise past Suomenlinna Maritime Fortress, a UNESCO World Heritage Site Hear about Helsinki’s rich maritime history from an onboard guide

Take train to Rovaniemi ( Tickets included for second class with seat reservation )
Upon arrival in Rovaniemi , self-transfers to Hotel. Check in at Rovaniemi Hotel , Take rest

days.title: Rovaniemi Northern Light Hunt with Campfire and BBQ with Transfer
days.body:
Morning – After breakfast Get ready for Rovaniemi self-guided tour Enjoy your free time
Evening Get ready for Northern lights adventure
Evening Rovaniemi Northern Lights
Description:
The Tour: Hunting Northern Lights with Lappish Barbecue
The Northern Lights are an amazing, natural spectacle, and for a lot of people the main reason they come to Lapland. Of course, you want to view the Northern Lights from the best possible location.
Inclusions: Guide in English (other languages available on request: German, French, Italian, Spanish, Chinese)|
Pick-up and drop off to your accommodation within 15km (driving distance) from Rovaniemi city center|
Winter clothes: overall and boots|
Transport around 20-25 km away from the City Lights|
Overnight stay at Rovaniemi Hotel

days.title: Santa Claus Village, Husky and Reindeers Combo Safari
days.body:
Join us for an exciting adventure to Husky park and reindeers, where you'll discover the
lives of Siberian huskies and reindeer. Our guided tour at the husky park provides insights into these
incredible dogs' daily routines and their role in Lapland. Plus, you'll experience the thrill of a sledge
ride with friendly huskies. Next, we'll visit a reindeer yard, where you can gain insights into their way
of life, and even enjoy a delightful 400m sledge ride. It's a hassle-free way to connect with nature and
experience the magic of Lapland. Don't miss this opportunity to create wonderful memories with
huskies and reindeer in the Arctic wilderness! But the magic doesn't stop there! You'll also visit Santa
Claus Village, where you can cross the Arctic Circle and meet Santa himself. Let your inner child
come alive as you share your Christmas wishes and capture the moment with Santa.
